关于市图书馆的故事(A Story about the city library: 一篇关于城市生活的A2短文:伊娃与汤姆的经历和小计划。

It takes twenty minutes to get to the city library by bike. Eva and Tom had great fun there. Eva thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Also, the overnight sleeper train arrives in Edinburgh at seven.
Last Friday, Eva and Tom went to the city library. Eva learned a lot about English. Eva wrote about the day in the diary. The set menu is good value for money.
Both of them like fish and milk. The weather was windy that day. Eva likes windy days best. The bus driver is friendly.
Tom is interested in swimming. Eva is going to travel to Sydney in September. Eva's favorite animal is the dog.
